title: 🌳 Identical Balanced Trees
description: ✅ Both balanced trees have identical structure and matching values.

title: 🔢 Different Root Values
description: ❌ The trees differ at their root values.

title: 🔍 Different Internal Values
description: ❌ The trees differ at an internal node value.

title: 🍃 Different Leaf Values
description: ❌ The trees differ only at a leaf node value.

title: ↙️ Left Skewed Match
description: ✅ Both trees follow the same left-skewed structure.

title: ↘️ Right Skewed Match
description: ✅ Both trees follow the same right-skewed structure.

title: 🔀 Left-Right Structure Mismatch
description: ❌ Corresponding children have different values and positions.

title: 🍂 Missing Leaf
description: ❌ One tree contains an additional leaf node.

title: 🧩 Deep Structure Mismatch
description: ❌ A deeper child exists on a different side of the tree.

title: ➖ Negative Values
description: ✅ Trees with negative values are structurally and numerically identical.

title: 🔁 Duplicate Values
description: ✅ Repeated values match at every corresponding position.

title: 🧩 Subtree Difference
description: ❌ One subtree has a different structure despite matching shared node values.
